evals.prompt: walk through the todo and backlog stories for the current sprint, tell me what's actually ready and who of chuu/don/tiger/me should take each one. don't change anything in shortcut
evals.expected_output: Loads .claude/sprint-triage.yml and passes the health check; reads only tracker-shortcut.md and host-github.md; produces the report-template report with a readiness verdict and evidence per story (API contract check, newest PM comment, blockers) and an owner proposal with one evidence line each. Calls no tracker write tools.

evals.prompt: Chuu is on leave from Wednesday until the end of the sprint. Re-propose owners for the stories in To Do in the current sprint, then assign them once I approve.
evals.expected_output: Uses the stated availability without asking again; moves Chuu's picks to others and justifies each; shows a numbered change list and waits for approval before any owner update; after approval, re-fetches and verifies.

evals.prompt: we plan sprint 19 on thursday. what does jui need to answer before then? draft the questions as comments but don't post them yet
evals.expected_output: Resolves the next (unstarted) sprint, focuses on concerns, drafts one comment per story that mentions the scope owner from the config with a concrete question, and posts nothing.

evals.prompt: jui added a bunch of stories to the sprint since planning. walk me through the new ones and tell me who could take them
evals.expected_output: Picks mid-sprint mode because a report with a snapshot for the current sprint exists; lists Added / Removed / Reopened against that snapshot (all states, not just To Do/Backlog); does not re-triage unchanged stories or propose changing existing owners; computes days left with workdays.sh and room per member including owned To Do stories; says whether the ready new stories fit, and if not drafts a swap question for the PM; saves a -mid report with a new snapshot.

evals.prompt: triage our current sprint please (run from a repo that has no .claude/sprint-triage.yml)
evals.expected_output: Says the config is missing and asks whether to create it; detects the tracker from connected MCP tools and the code host from the git remote; discovers team, states and people through the adapter; shows the full YAML and whether the path is gitignored; writes it only after the user agrees; runs the health check before triaging.
